title: HeadlessAppRuntimeLogResponse
description: Response object for looking up headless storefront runtime logs.

isTruncated.description: Flag to indicate if all results were returned. If IsTruncated is true, use NextToken to retrieve additional results.

logs.description: A list of items representing headless application build jobs.

maxResults.description: The max result provided in runtime log lookup

nextToken.description: A token used for paginating through runtime logs on subsequent requests.

prefix.description: The prefix provided in runtime log lookup

HeadlessAppRuntimeLog.description: Response object representing a s3 object containing headless storefront runtime logs.

key.description: The key for the s3 log object.

logUrl.description: The presigned URL to download the log collection, valid for 4 hours.

size.description: The size of the log collection
